decisions.subject: Production pipeline for a last-30-days viral short

options_considered.label: animated-explainer
options_considered.reason: Generated explainer from a researched topic; research → proposal → script → 9:16 kinetic compose.

options_considered.label: cinematic
options_considered.reason: Wrong grammar for a 30s mute-first stat slam.
options_considered.rejected_because: Needs footage-led cinematic motion, not a trending-paper Short.

options_considered.label: nexus-true-crime-short
options_considered.reason: Brand pipeline for historical crime, not AI research.

decisions.reason: User asked to create a viral video about something trending now. animated-explainer is the generated-explainer path; short-form.md supplies 9:16 / 30s / mute-caption rules.

decisions.subject: Which researched angle becomes the A-story

options_considered.label: The 150M underdog (30s 9:16)
options_considered.reason: Frame-1 number + last-30-days paper rank + cost slam. Built for mute.

options_considered.label: Reasoning without a diary (60s 16:9)
options_considered.reason: Strong mechanism story, slower hook.
options_considered.rejected_because: User asked for viral; 60s 16:9 loses the 1-second interrupt.

options_considered.label: Qwen vs the 150M paper (45s)
options_considered.reason: likes30d contrast is real, but it makes Qwen the star.
options_considered.rejected_because: A-story should be the #1 paper, not the likes chart.

decisions.reason: Production request is a viral short about what is trending now. c1 front-loads the 150M hook and uses Hub papers/trending as the why-now.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime for the 9:16 short

options_considered.label: Remotion (React scene stack)
options_considered.reason: Best at word-level captions and Explainer scene-types — but Explainer is 1920x1080, remotion-composer/node_modules is empty, and npm/PyPI TLS is blocked in this environment.
options_considered.rejected_because: runtime not available on this machine

options_considered.label: HyperFrames (HTML/CSS/GSAP)
options_considered.reason: Best at kinetic typography and 9:16 motion-graphics for this brief. npx hyperframes cannot fetch in this allowlisted environment.
options_considered.rejected_because: runtime not available on this machine

options_considered.label: FFmpeg (Ken Burns + ASS captions + generated bed)
options_considered.reason: ffmpeg 6.1.1 is present. Can deliver 1080x1920, H.264 High, burned captions in the 900x1400 safe zone, and a 30s music bed with no cloud keys.

decisions.reason: Both Remotion and HyperFrames were evaluated for this brief. Remotion would own karaoke captions if Node deps were installed; HyperFrames would own kinetic type if npx could reach the registry. Neither runtime is available here, so ffmpeg is locked — not silently swapped later.

decisions.subject: Templated vs atelier authoring

options_considered.label: Templated ffmpeg kinetic type
options_considered.reason: Locked ffmpeg runtime: Ken Burns stills + ASS slams is a template grammar, not a Remotion atelier project.

options_considered.label: Hand-authored Remotion/HyperFrames composition
options_considered.reason: Right for a hero explainer if a JS runtime were available.
options_considered.rejected_because: No Remotion/HyperFrames runtime on this machine; atelier entry would not render.

decisions.reason: Runtime is ffmpeg. Atelier is a Remotion/HyperFrames authoring mode and cannot be honored without those engines.

decisions.subject: Creative grammar

options_considered.label: explainer-data
options_considered.reason: The video is two numbers and a contrast, not a teacher at a whiteboard.

options_considered.label: explainer-teacher
options_considered.reason: No presenter, no chalkboard.

decisions.reason: Stat slams + mechanism line. Matches delivery_promise data_explainer.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: Piper (local, free)
options_considered.reason: Documented zero-key TTS for this repo.
options_considered.rejected_because: Piper binary not installed on this machine.

options_considered.label: OpenAI TTS
options_considered.reason: Would match an energetic explainer voice.
options_considered.rejected_because: No reachable TTS API (allowlist + no key path that works here).

options_considered.label: Captions + music bed (no VO)
options_considered.reason: 85% of short-form is watched muted; kinetic type is the primary track. Honest given TTS absence.

decisions.reason: No local or cloud TTS is available. Short-form.md already requires burned captions; the VO track is the caption track.

decisions.subject: Background music

options_considered.label: Pixabay stock bed
options_considered.reason: Usual zero-key music source.
options_considered.rejected_because: Outbound HTTPS to stock hosts is blocked here.

options_considered.label: Generated 100 BPM dark bed (ffmpeg/numpy)
options_considered.reason: Starts at frame 0, slams on scene cuts, loudnorm to Shorts levels, no license fetch.

options_considered.label: Silence
options_considered.reason: Would feel unfinished on sound-on autoplay.

decisions.reason: Need an immediate bed; cannot download stock. Procedural 100 BPM drone with cut slams.

decisions.subject: Style playbook

options_considered.label: Flat Motion Graphics (adapted dark cyan/amber)
options_considered.reason: Recommended for TikTok/Reels explainers; we keep the bold type and swap the purple pack for cyan/amber so it does not look like every other startup pitch.

options_considered.label: Clean Professional
options_considered.reason: Too corporate for a 1-second interrupt.
options_considered.rejected_because: Low motion intensity for viral Shorts.

decisions.reason: Pipeline recommended playbook for social explainers, with a documented palette override (cyan #00E5FF / amber #FFB020 / navy #05080F).

decisions.subject: Still generation after Z-Image download blocked

options_considered.label: Hugging Face Z-Image Turbo 9:16 stills
options_considered.reason: Five 720x1280 stills generated successfully via gr1_z_image_turbo_generate.
options_considered.rejected_because: TLS to mcp-tools-z-image-turbo.hf.space reset; files never landed on disk.

options_considered.label: Procedural 1080x1920 stills (numpy + ffmpeg)
options_considered.reason: Same five-scene story (lattice, ranked cards, penny/grid, latent spiral, data-center aisle) rendered locally with grain, vignette, cyan/amber.

decisions.reason: Keep the shot list; replace the blocked Hub files with generated stills so compose can proceed. Not a runtime swap.
